findings.text: follow-on: the re-arm runs only in pytest_runtest_setup, so a store reload during a test body leaves the wrapper absent for that test's teardown and for any module-scoped fixture teardown before the next test's setup, where a cache-root resolution would go unrecorded.

follow-on: the repair is validated only by the reload-family selection, and no whole-suite arm exists at the repaired head d3c02bc40, so the done_when's no-added-failure condition is unverified at the revision that merges.

follow-on: the record calls the 2c5205f12 whole-suite run the third whole-suite run at head while the reviewed head is d3c02bc40, so a reader must resolve the revision from the log rather than from the prose.
